```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(shiny)
library(shinyWidgets)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(targets)

# Null-coalescing operator
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0 || is.na(a)) b else a

# Helper function to create consistent pickerInput
make_picker <- function(inputId, label, choices, selected = choices[1]) {
  pickerInput(
    inputId = inputId,
    label = label,
    choices = choices,
    selected = selected,
    multiple = TRUE,
    width = "100%",
    options = pickerOptions(
      actionsBox = TRUE,
      liveSearch = length(choices) > 10,
      selectedTextFormat = "count > 2",
      countSelectedText = "{0} selezionati",
      noneSelectedText = "Seleziona...",
      selectAllText = "Tutti",
      deselectAllText = "Nessuno",
      container = "body",
      size = 10
    )
  )
}

# 1. Load combined datasets (already merged from filtered + forecast) -----
tar_load(combined_150_908_Q, store = "_targets")
tar_load(combined_150_915_Q, store = "_targets")
tar_load(combined_150_916_Q, store = "_targets")
tar_load(combined_150_938_Q, store = "_targets")
tar_load(combined_151_914_Q, store = "_targets")
tar_load(combined_151_929_Q, store = "_targets")
tar_load(combined_152_913_Q, store = "_targets")
tar_load(combined_152_928_Q, store = "_targets")
tar_load(combined_532_930_Q, store = "_targets")
tar_load(combined_534_1037_Q, store = "_targets")
tar_load(combined_534_1038_Q, store = "_targets")
tar_load(combined_154_373_Q, store = "_targets")

# 2. Add dataset identifier to each -----
combined_150_908_Q[, dataset := "150_908 - Forze di lavoro"]
combined_150_915_Q[, dataset := "150_915 - Tasso di occupazione"]
combined_150_916_Q[, dataset := "150_916 - Tasso di attivita"]
combined_150_938_Q[, dataset := "150_938 - Occupati (migliaia)"]
combined_151_914_Q[, dataset := "151_914 - Tasso di disoccupazione"]
combined_151_929_Q[, dataset := "151_929 - Disoccupati"]
combined_152_913_Q[, dataset := "152_913 - Tasso di inattivita"]
combined_152_928_Q[, dataset := "152_928 - Inattivi"]
combined_532_930_Q[, dataset := "532_930 - Popolazione per condizione"]
combined_534_1037_Q[, dataset := "534_1037 - Ore lavorate imprese"]
combined_534_1038_Q[, dataset := "534_1038 - Posti vacanti"]
combined_154_373_Q[, dataset := "154_373 - Imprese con dipendenti"]

# 3. Combine all datasets -----
all_data <- rbindlist(list(
  combined_150_908_Q, combined_150_915_Q, combined_150_916_Q, combined_150_938_Q,
  combined_151_914_Q, combined_151_929_Q, combined_152_913_Q, combined_152_928_Q,
  combined_532_930_Q, combined_534_1037_Q, combined_534_1038_Q, combined_154_373_Q
), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

# 4. Ensure tempo is Date -----
if (!inherits(all_data$tempo, "Date")) {
  all_data[, tempo := as.Date(tempo)]
}

# 5. Get all possible label columns (for dynamic filtering) -----
all_label_cols <- grep("_label$", names(all_data), value = TRUE)

# 6. Clean up -----
rm(combined_150_908_Q, combined_150_915_Q, combined_150_916_Q, combined_150_938_Q,
   combined_151_914_Q, combined_151_929_Q, combined_152_913_Q, combined_152_928_Q,
   combined_532_930_Q, combined_534_1037_Q, combined_534_1038_Q, combined_154_373_Q)
```

```{r}
# Dataset selector
selectInput("dataset", "Dataset:",
            choices = sort(unique(all_data$dataset)),
            selected = sort(unique(all_data$dataset))[1])

# Forecast controls
checkboxInput("show_forecast", "Mostra previsioni", value = TRUE)

selectInput("ci_level", "Intervallo di confidenza:",
            choices = c("Nessuno" = "none", "80%" = "80", "95%" = "95"),
            selected = "95")

hr()

# Date range selector
dateRangeInput("date_range",
               "Intervallo date:",
               start = min(all_data$tempo),
               end = max(all_data$tempo),
               min = min(all_data$tempo),
               max = max(all_data$tempo),
               format = "yyyy-mm",
               separator = " - ",
               language = "it")

hr()

# Dynamic filter outputs
uiOutput("filter1_ui")
uiOutput("filter2_ui")
uiOutput("filter3_ui")
uiOutput("filter4_ui")
uiOutput("filter5_ui")
uiOutput("filter6_ui")

hr()

# Download controls
h5("Esporta")
selectInput("download_format", "Formato:", choices = c("PNG" = "png", "PDF" = "pdf"))
downloadButton("download_plot", "Scarica grafico", icon = icon("download"))
```

```{r context="server"}
# 1. Helper function to get available label columns for current dataset -----
get_dataset_label_cols <- reactive({
  req(input$dataset)
  dt <- all_data[dataset == input$dataset]

  # Get label columns that have non-NA values in this dataset
  label_cols <- grep("_label$", names(dt), value = TRUE)
  available <- sapply(label_cols, function(col) {
    any(!is.na(dt[[col]]))
  })

  names(available)[available]
})

# 2. Filtered data after dataset selection -----
data_after_dataset <- reactive({
  req(input$dataset)
  all_data[dataset == input$dataset]
})

# 3. Dynamic filter generation -----
# Maps label column names to Italian display names
label_names <- c(
  "REF_AREA_label" = "Territorio",
  "SEX_label" = "Sesso",
  "AGE_label" = "Classe di eta",
  "EDU_LEV_HIGHEST_label" = "Livello di istruzione",
  "CITIZENSHIP_label" = "Cittadinanza",
  "DURATION_UNEMPLOYMENT_label" = "Durata disoccupazione",
  "EURO_LABOUR_STATUS_label" = "Condizione professionale",
  "DATA_TYPE_label" = "Tipo di dato",
  "ADJUSTMENT_label" = "Correzione",
  "EMPLOYESS_CLASS_label" = "Classe di dipendenti",
  "ECON_ACTIVITY_NACE_2007_label" = "Attivita economica"
)

# Filter 1
output$filter1_ui <- renderUI({
  cols <- get_dataset_label_cols()
  if (length(cols) >= 1) {
    col <- cols[1]
    choices <- sort(unique(na.omit(data_after_dataset()[[col]])))
    if (length(choices) > 0) {
      make_picker("filter1", label_names[col] %||% col, choices)
    }
  }
})

data_after_filter1 <- reactive({
  cols <- get_dataset_label_cols()
  dt <- data_after_dataset()
  if (length(cols) >= 1 && !is.null(input$filter1) && length(input$filter1) > 0) {
    col <- cols[1]
    dt <- dt[get(col) %in% input$filter1 | is.na(get(col))]
  }
  dt
})

# Final filtered data
filtered_data <- reactive({
  cols <- get_dataset_label_cols()
  dt <- data_after_filter5()
  if (length(cols) >= 6 && !is.null(input$filter6) && length(input$filter6) > 0) {
    col <- cols[6]
    dt <- dt[get(col) %in% input$filter6 | is.na(get(col))]
  }
  # Apply date range filter
  if (!is.null(input$date_range)) {
    dt <- dt[tempo >= input$date_range[1] & tempo <= input$date_range[2]]
  }
  dt
})

# Reactive plot object for rendering and download
plot_object <- reactive({
  req(nrow(filtered_data()) > 0)

  plot_data <- filtered_data()[order(tempo)]
  cols <- get_dataset_label_cols()

  # Build series identifier from columns with multiple selections
  series_cols <- c()
  if (length(cols) >= 1 && !is.null(input$filter1) && length(input$filter1) > 1) {
    series_cols <- c(series_cols, cols[1])
  }
  if (length(cols) >= 2 && !is.null(input$filter2) && length(input$filter2) > 1) {
    series_cols <- c(series_cols, cols[2])
  }
  if (length(cols) >= 3 && !is.null(input$filter3) && length(input$filter3) > 1) {
    series_cols <- c(series_cols, cols[3])
  }
  if (length(cols) >= 4 && !is.null(input$filter4) && length(input$filter4) > 1) {
    series_cols <- c(series_cols, cols[4])
  }
  if (length(cols) >= 5 && !is.null(input$filter5) && length(input$filter5) > 1) {
    series_cols <- c(series_cols, cols[5])
  }
  if (length(cols) >= 6 && !is.null(input$filter6) && length(input$filter6) > 1) {
    series_cols <- c(series_cols, cols[6])
  }

  # Create series label column
  if (length(series_cols) > 0) {
    plot_data[, series := do.call(paste, c(.SD, sep = " - ")), .SDcols = series_cols]
  } else {
    plot_data[, series := "Serie"]
  }

  # Split historical and forecast data
  hist_data <- plot_data[type == "historical"]
  fc_data <- plot_data[type == "forecast"]

  # Create title from dataset
  plot_title <- gsub("^[0-9_]+ - ", "", input$dataset)

  # Build subtitle from filters with single selection
  subtitle_parts <- c()
  if (length(cols) >= 1 && !is.null(input$filter1) && length(input$filter1) == 1) {
    subtitle_parts <- c(subtitle_parts, input$filter1)
  }
  if (length(cols) >= 2 && !is.null(input$filter2) && length(input$filter2) == 1) {
    subtitle_parts <- c(subtitle_parts, input$filter2)
  }
  if (length(cols) >= 3 && !is.null(input$filter3) && length(input$filter3) == 1) {
    subtitle_parts <- c(subtitle_parts, input$filter3)
  }
  plot_subtitle <- paste(subtitle_parts[1:min(3, length(subtitle_parts))], collapse = " - ")

  # Check if we have multiple series
  n_series <- length(unique(plot_data$series))

  if (n_series > 1) {
    # Multiple series: use color aesthetic
    p <- ggplot() +
      geom_line(data = hist_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore, color = series, group = series),
                linewidth = 1) +
      geom_point(data = hist_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore, color = series),
                 size = 2, alpha = 0.7)

    # Add forecast if enabled
    if (input$show_forecast && nrow(fc_data) > 0) {
      if (input$ci_level == "95" && "lower_95" %in% names(fc_data)) {
        p <- p + geom_ribbon(data = fc_data,
                             aes(x = tempo, ymin = lower_95, ymax = upper_95, fill = series, group = series),
                             alpha = 0.15)
      } else if (input$ci_level == "80" && "lower_80" %in% names(fc_data)) {
        p <- p + geom_ribbon(data = fc_data,
                             aes(x = tempo, ymin = lower_80, ymax = upper_80, fill = series, group = series),
                             alpha = 0.2)
      }

      p <- p +
        geom_line(data = fc_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore_forecast, color = series, group = series),
                  linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
        geom_point(data = fc_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore_forecast, color = series),
                   size = 2)
    }

    p <- p + labs(color = "Serie", fill = "Serie")

  } else {
    # Single series: use fixed colors
    p <- ggplot() +
      geom_line(data = hist_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore),
                color = "#2c3e50", linewidth = 1) +
      geom_point(data = hist_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore),
                 color = "#2c3e50", size = 2, alpha = 0.7)

    if (input$show_forecast && nrow(fc_data) > 0) {
      if (input$ci_level == "95" && "lower_95" %in% names(fc_data)) {
        p <- p + geom_ribbon(data = fc_data,
                             aes(x = tempo, ymin = lower_95, ymax = upper_95),
                             fill = "#3498db", alpha = 0.2)
      } else if (input$ci_level == "80" && "lower_80" %in% names(fc_data)) {
        p <- p + geom_ribbon(data = fc_data,
                             aes(x = tempo, ymin = lower_80, ymax = upper_80),
                             fill = "#3498db", alpha = 0.3)
      }

      p <- p +
        geom_line(data = fc_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore_forecast),
                  color = "#3498db", linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
        geom_point(data = fc_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore_forecast),
                   color = "#3498db", size = 2)
    }
  }

  p +
    scale_x_date(date_labels = "%Y-%m", date_breaks = "1 year") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma_format(decimal.mark = ",", big.mark = ".")) +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      subtitle = plot_subtitle,
      x = NULL,
      y = "Valore",
      caption = paste("Dataset:", input$dataset)
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray40", size = 11),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 2), fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2))
})

# Download handler
output$download_plot <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() {
    dataset_name <- gsub(" - .*$", "", input$dataset)
    timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    paste0("grafico_", dataset_name, "_", timestamp, ".", input$download_format)
  },
  content = function(file) {
    p <- plot_object()
    if (input$download_format == "png") {
      ggsave(file, plot = p, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    } else {
      ggsave(file, plot = p, width = 10, height = 6, device = cairo_pdf)
    }
  }
)
```

### Dati

```{r}
renderTable({
  req(nrow(filtered_data()) > 0)

  dt <- filtered_data()[order(-tempo)]

  # Show only historical if forecast disabled
  if (!input$show_forecast) {
    dt <- dt[type == "historical"]
  }

  # Format quarter for display
  result <- dt[, .(
    Trimestre = paste0(format(tempo, "%Y"), "-", quarters(tempo)),
    Valore = fifelse(
      type == "historical",
      format(round(valore, 2), decimal.mark = ",", big.mark = "."),
      paste0(format(round(valore_forecast, 2), decimal.mark = ",", big.mark = "."), " *")
    ),
    Tipo = fifelse(type == "historical", "Storico", "Previsione")
  )]

  head(result, 24)
}, striped = TRUE, hover = TRUE, spacing = "s")
```
